user.title: Connect to HPE Central
user.description: Pick the Central cluster your account is on (its API gateway), or type another base URL. Use a Central API client (client id and secret) from HPE GreenLake; it needs read access to monitoring. The secret is stored only in this config entry.

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: Pick the sites to bring into Home Assistant. Leave all ticked to include every site, also ones added later.

error.invalid_auth: GreenLake or Central refused this client id / secret.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Central at that base URL.

abort.already_configured: This Central account is already set up.

init.title: Clients
init.description: Any client Central lists works, wired or Wi-Fi: phone, laptop, car, printer, IoT device. The list shows clients connected now and clients this integration saw in the last 7 days (name · ip · mac · vendor · when). Tick clients to track, or type the MAC of one that is not listed (separate several with commas). For a phone, use an address that stays the same for this network, not a rotating one.

data.add_all_clients: Add all other clients (disabled until you enable them)

data_description.add_all_clients: Every client Central reports gets a tracker you can enable in one click under Entities. Ticked clients are always enabled and get their own device.
data_description.sites: Leave all ticked to include every site, also ones added later.

names.title: Name each client
names.description:
The name becomes the device and the tracker entity.

{clients}

error.invalid_mac: That is not a MAC address (like 02:00:00:00:00:01).
error.invalid_auth: Central refused the saved client id / secret; remove and add the integration again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not list connected clients from Central right now. You can still type a MAC.
